settings.auto-removes: Auto-removes client resources (shaders, resource packs) by side
settings.beta-gets: Beta gets new features first, and new bugs too: conversions and task saves may hit unexpected states. Only switch if you don't mind reporting bugs.
settings.cache-loader: Cache per loader & version; later packs reuse it
settings.check-updates: Check for updates will find pre-release Beta packs
settings.converting-partial: · Converting; partial downloads in progress not counted
settings.defaults-system: Defaults to System; pin Light or Dark
settings.env-lookup-source-desc: Ask one source when pack evidence is thin (never both); "No lookup" sends no request
settings.leftover-staging: Leftover staging & empty dirs from failed/crashed downloads
settings.lookup-off-desc: Sends no request — only pack self-proof, the local index and name fallback
settings.mcmod-lookup-desc: When all platform legs come up empty, look up the MC Wiki entry's runtime-environment line (unofficial, off by default)
settings.mcmod-lookup-inert: Has no effect while side lookup is off
settings.modrinth-mirror-desc: Search/detail/versions/translations from Modrinth prefer the mcimirror proxy with official fallback; CurseForge data always comes via mcimirror (no API key needed)
settings.pinned-choice: Pinned to your choice; no longer decided by build version
settings.pinned-choice-longer: Pinned to your choice; it no longer follows the system language
settings.post-build: Post-build offline check: mods present, jars valid, deps kept
settings.prefer-cn: Prefer CN mirrors, fall back to official automatically
settings.runs-forge: Runs the Forge/NeoForge installer locally; needs local Java
settings.switch-back: Switch back to Stable anytime; Beta packs may have unseen bugs
settings.switched-beta: Switched to Beta: update checks will now get Beta builds
settings.threads-mod: Threads for parallel file downloads (1-16); side lookups use a fixed one
settings.use-another: In use by another program — no {{name}} could be deleted
settings.used-days: ; all used within {{days}} days, nothing stale
settings.where-finished: Where finished server packs are saved
settings.installs-count: {{count}} version(s) · the same version re-downloads on next conversion
